messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired: high CUDA alloc failure rate in gpu-pool-usw2 (service: inference-hosted). Alert id=PD-76412

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-76412 triggered and notified oncall. Escalation level 1.

alex_l: acked. i'll start digging. any indicators of customer-facing errors?

sasha: seeing a spike in 503s for /v1/embeddings in region us-west2 — +9% error rate over baseline. graphs: https://metrics.internal/redwood/PD-76412 (short link)

mohamed: logs from node gpu-pool-usw2-3: 
```
2026-06-24T02:12:01Z inference-server[pid=8341]: model=llama-70b quant=8bit step=1123 -> cudaAlloc failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (requested 2147483648 bytes)
2026-06-24T02:12:01Z inference-server[pid=8341]: stack: /opt/redwood/lib/cuda_kernels.so+0x7a13c
2026-06-24T02:12:02Z k8s kubelet: OOMKiller invoked on container redwood-inference
```

alex_l: ok that looks like legitimate OOMs not just transient alloc spikes. which model pods are hottest?

sasha: top offenders: model-server-llama-70b-3 (node gpu-pool-usw2-3), model-server-llama-70b-5 (same node). Memory usage pinned ~98%.

mohamed: running `kubectl top pod -n inference | grep llama-70b` shows RSS near device mem limit.

alex_l: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon + drain gpu-pool-usw2-3 to stop new allocations 2) reroute traffic away from affected AZ by updating routing policy 3) scale up warm standby capacity in us-west2 if autoscaling slow

rachel: doing cordon/drain now: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-usw2-3 && kubectl drain gpu-pool-usw2-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

alex_l: i will flip routing to prefer us-west1 and us-east1 for hosted inference for the next 20m: `route set-weight hosted-api region=us-west2 weight=0.2`

pagerduty-bot: PD-76412 acknowledged by alex_l (level 1).

jamie: heads up — customers on dedicated clusters unaffected per telemetry. this is only hosted infra so far.

sasha: impact: ~120 active requests failed in the last 10m (mostly embeddings). estimated customer impact: low-medium; some PLG customers may see degraded UX.

mohamed: i restarted model-server-llama-70b-3 container after drain; it comes back but memory climbs quickly; suspect a memory leak or KV-cache misuse under long contexts.

alex_l: good catch. while investigating, temporarily reduce batch size for llama-70b in hosted profile to 1 to reduce peak allocations: `config set serving.batch_size.llama-70b=1 --env=hosted`

rachel: batch size change applied. pushing config via canary to 10% first. monitoring.

sasha: error rate dropped to +3% over baseline after routing + batch change. OOM events still every ~3-5 min on that node though.

mohamed: capturing heap traces from the process now. attaching snippet: `gdb --pid=8341 -ex "thread apply all bt" -ex detach -ex quit` - looks like kv_cache.c:alloc_shard grows unbounded under long prefix reuse.

alex_l: okay next steps: 1) keep node drained 2) cordon the node permanently for this pool and repro on a test node 3) schedule hotfix to reset KV cache every X requests for streaming sessions older than 5 minutes 4) create alert threshold on cuda_alloc_failures > 3 in 5m to auto-scale or evict pods

jamie: i'm taking the handoff at 03:00 UTC (in 20m). alex, please add a short runbook note in the thread for the next oncall: what you did, where traces uploaded, flags toggled.

alex_l: noted. uploaded heap dumps to s3://redwood-uploads/PD-76412/ and added links in the incident ticket. runbook snippet: 
```
If PD-76412-like OOMs: 1) cordon+drain impacted node 2) reduce batch_size for model 3) flip traffic off region 4) restart model pods after drain 5) capture heap dump and upload
```

mohamed: filing follow-up: set KV_CACHE_RESET_INTERVAL=300s in hosted env and test on staging. creating PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3245

rachel: removing node from rotation, confirmed no new allocations there.

sasha: monitoring graphs for 15 minutes then we'll mark mitigated. current error delta down to +1.2%.

oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff to jamie in 18m.

jamie: i have the handoff. alex — anything you want me to watch specifically?

alex_l: watch for repeat OOMs in other nodes, KV cache growth, and any rollback requests from product. keep PD incident open until we have root cause and fix plan.

jamie: ack. i will stay on the thread and update customer-impact channel with a short note.

pagerduty-bot: PD-76412 status changed to "under investigation" (acknowledged).

incident-bot: mitigation: routing + batch-size reduction + node drain applied. ongoing: heap dump analysis and KV reset PR.

jamie: marking this thread as active mitigation. will escalate to eng-runtime if we see more nodes fail.

alex_l: postmortem tasks: 1) add automatic eviction for pods with >95% sustained device memory for 2m 2) add unit test for kv cache leak with long prefix reuse 3) schedule 2h blameless postmortem tomorrow at 15:00 PT.

jamie: thanks all. dropping the short customer note in #customer-impact now. looping in eng-runtime and infra for hotfix next 24h.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff complete. jamie is now oncall.

jamie: closing my monitoring window for 30m; will reopen if anything spikes. leaving PD incident open until PR merged and staging validation passes.

incident-bot: thread archived for active mitigation updates only."
